import cuda.tile as ct
import cupy as cp
import numpy as np

ConstInt = ct.Constant[int]

# --- tunable tile sizes (vary these to autotune) ---
TILE_S = (512, 512)
TILE_Ss = (512, 512)
TILE_mx = (512, 512)
TILE_sb = (512, 512)
TILE_e = (512, 512)
TILE_sm = (512, 512)
TILE_P = (512, 512)
TILE_O = (512, 64)

@ct.kernel
def S_kernel(Q, KT, S, DD: ConstInt, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(Q, (0, 0), (I, DD))
    t2 = ct.load(KT, (0, 0), (DD, J))
    t3 = ct.matmul(t1, t2)
    ct.store(S, (0, 0), t3)

@ct.kernel
def Ss_kernel(S, Ss, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(S, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = (t1 * 0.125)
    ct.store(Ss, (0, 0), t2)

@ct.kernel
def mx_kernel(Ss, mx, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(Ss, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.max(t1, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    ct.store(mx, (0, 0), t2)

@ct.kernel
def sb_kernel(Ss, mx, sb, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(Ss, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.load(mx, (0, 0), (I, 1))
    t3 = (t1 - t2)
    ct.store(sb, (0, 0), t3)

@ct.kernel
def e_kernel(sb, e, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(sb, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.exp(t1)
    ct.store(e, (0, 0), t2)

@ct.kernel
def sm_kernel(e, sm, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(e, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.sum(t1, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    ct.store(sm, (0, 0), t2)

@ct.kernel
def P_kernel(e, sm, P, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    j = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(e, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.load(sm, (0, 0), (I, 1))
    t3 = (t1 / t2)
    ct.store(P, (0, 0), t3)

@ct.kernel
def O_kernel(P, V, O, DD: ConstInt, I: ConstInt, J: ConstInt):
    i = ct.bid(0)
    dd = ct.bid(1)
    t1 = ct.load(P, (0, 0), (I, J))
    t2 = ct.load(V, (0, 0), (J, DD))
    t3 = ct.matmul(t1, t2)
    ct.store(O, (0, 0), t3)

def fn(KT, Q, V):
    dtype = KT.dtype
    stream = cp.cuda.get_current_stream()
    P = cp.zeros((512, 512), dtype=dtype)
    S = cp.zeros((512, 512), dtype=dtype)
    Ss = cp.zeros((512, 512), dtype=dtype)
    e = cp.zeros((512, 512), dtype=dtype)
    mx = cp.zeros((512, 1), dtype=dtype)
    sb = cp.zeros((512, 512), dtype=dtype)
    sm = cp.zeros((512, 1), dtype=dtype)
    O = cp.zeros((512, 64), dtype=dtype)
    grid = (ct.cdiv(S.shape[0], TILE_S[0]), ct.cdiv(S.shape[1], TILE_S[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, S_kernel, (Q, KT, S, 64, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(Ss.shape[0], TILE_Ss[0]), ct.cdiv(Ss.shape[1], TILE_Ss[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, Ss_kernel, (S, Ss, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(mx.shape[0], TILE_mx[0]), ct.cdiv(mx.shape[1], TILE_mx[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, mx_kernel, (Ss, mx, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(sb.shape[0], TILE_sb[0]), ct.cdiv(sb.shape[1], TILE_sb[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, sb_kernel, (Ss, mx, sb, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(e.shape[0], TILE_e[0]), ct.cdiv(e.shape[1], TILE_e[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, e_kernel, (sb, e, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(sm.shape[0], TILE_sm[0]), ct.cdiv(sm.shape[1], TILE_sm[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, sm_kernel, (e, sm, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(P.shape[0], TILE_P[0]), ct.cdiv(P.shape[1], TILE_P[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, P_kernel, (e, sm, P, 512, 512))
    grid = (ct.cdiv(O.shape[0], TILE_O[0]), ct.cdiv(O.shape[1], TILE_O[1]), 1)
    ct.launch(stream, grid, O_kernel, (P, V, O, 64, 512, 512))
    return O

KERNEL_META = {'inputs': [['KT', [64, 512]], ['Q', [512, 64]], ['V', [512, 64]]], 'output': ['O', [512, 64]], 'flops': 68681728, 'flops_exact': True}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = [cp.random.randn(*s, dtype=cp.float32) for _, s in KERNEL_META["inputs"]]
    out = fn(*args)
    cp.cuda.runtime.deviceSynchronize()
    print("ran:", KERNEL_META["inputs"], "->", list(out.shape))
